purpose: Teach: アラスカ/アインシュタイン/トライアル/電話機/ブーツ/石鹸/キャスター/セレクト

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアラスカクルーズに行きたいって言ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying he wants to go on an Alaska cruise.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle delivery — sharing a piece of news that might interest him. Slight lift in the middle, like she's offering it to him. Natural maternal tone, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがアインシュタインの話してくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me about Einstein!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick attack on the opening word. Eager to share — like he's been waiting to tell her. Slight breathlessness. Genuine child delight, no performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、新ゲームのトライアル版、お父さんと試したの?
lines.en: Sho, did you and Dad try out that new game trial together?
lines.style: Warm curiosity, genuinely interested in what he did with his father. Soft question-mark energy at the end. Attentive without pressure — the tone of someone actually listening for the answer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの電話機、おもしろい音がするよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa's phone makes a funny sound!
lines.style: Alert and delighted. Slight emphasis on 'funny' like he's just noticed something strange and wonderful. Quick cadence. The unfiltered observation of a six-year-old who finds the small details interesting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、雪の日はブーツを履いてね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you wear your boots on snowy days, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, practical instruction. Not stern — more like a quiet reminder wrapped in care. Steady pace. The tone of someone who's said this before and will say it again without frustration.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの手作り石鹸が好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really like Grandma's handmade soap!
lines.style: Sincere appreciation without self-consciousness. Simple, direct statement. Soft warmth — he's not trying to please, just expressing something true. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃん、テレビのキャスターと知り合いなんだって
lines.en: Sho, apparently your grandpa knows someone who works as a TV news anchor.
lines.style: Conversational, sharing a small discovery. Tone of mild interest — not a big deal, but interesting enough to mention. Measured pace. The 'apparently' is gentle, not gossipy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんへのプレゼント、セレクトするよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to pick out a present for Grandma!
lines.style: Determined and pleased with himself. Slight emphasis on 'I'm going to' — he's announcing a decision he's made. Warm, proud tone. The cadence of a child who's thought of something good and wants to do it.
